Module 05: Human vs. AI Reconciliation — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Explain the methodology of independent double-transcription and why post-editing proofreading suffers from cognitive confirmation bias.
  • Execute structured, negative-constraint prompt engineering in VS Code Antigravity to produce an un-normalized machine diplomatic baseline (transcription_ai.xml).
  • Use VS Code's side-by-side visual diff viewer to isolate character- and word-level discrepancies between human and machine passes.
  • Adjudicate competing editorial readings against high-resolution facsimiles using a four-part discrepancy taxonomy to synthesize an authoritative consensus edition (transcription_reconciled.xml).
